title: OmaRemotes
subtitle: Pick a machine. Take control.
launchKeys: Press a row’s key to connect · / to search
searchKeys: Typing searches · ↓ to browse · Enter opens a single match
ready: Choose a machine to open its desktop.
fit: Fits the remote desktop to your window
connectionFailed: The connection stopped. Try again to reconnect.
waitingForDesktop: Signed in. Waiting for the desktop…
login: Finish signing in in the control window.
closed: Control window closed. Connect again when you’re ready.
tailscaleNote: Tailscale availability refreshes every 15 seconds. Screen control is checked when you connect.
tailscaleMissing: Tailscale status unavailable. Availability stays unknown; you can still try connecting.
